019package org.apache.bcel.verifier.exc;
020
021/**
022 * Instances of this class are thrown by BCEL's class file verifier "JustIce" when a class file to verify does not pass
023 * the verification pass 3 because of a violation of a static constraint as described in the Java Virtual Machine
024 * Specification, Second edition, 4.8.1, pages 133-137. The static constraints checking part of pass 3 is called pass 3a
025 * in JustIce. Static constraints on the instructions in the code array are checked early in pass 3a and are described
026 * on page 134 in the Java Virtual Machine Specification, Second Edition.
027 */
028public class StaticCodeInstructionConstraintException extends StaticCodeConstraintException {
029    private static final long serialVersionUID = 4987255974346614794L;
030
031    public StaticCodeInstructionConstraintException(final String message) {
032        super(message);
033    }
034}
